description: Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist | Ethiopia | 12 Month Contract The Government of Ethiopia has committed to accelerating progress toward universal, reliable, affordable, and sustainable electricity access and achieving the objectives of the Mission 300 (M300) initiative.
